title: Dak Prescott did not appreciate stadium worker calling Cowboys' loss "embarrassing"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dak Prescott did not appreciate stadium worker calling Cowboys' loss "embarrassing"
sources.description: "Feel free to speak your mind. Just speak it. Don't coward away from the reaction that you're going to get," Prescott said of his exchange with the worker in the tunnel after the game.
